steps.name: Prepare Release Notes Context
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

git fetch --tags --force origin

CURRENT_TAG="$RELEASE_VERSION"
CURRENT_COMMIT="$(git rev-list -n 1 "$CURRENT_TAG")"
test "$CURRENT_COMMIT" = "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sha }}"
REMOTE_COMMIT="$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$CURRENT_TAG^{}" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$REMOTE_COMMIT" = "$CURRENT_COMMIT"
PREVIOUS_TAG="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' "${CURRENT_COMMIT}^" 2>/dev/null || true)"
EMPTY_TREE="4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904"

if [ -n "$PREVIOUS_TAG" ]; then
  RANGE_LABEL="$PREVIOUS_TAG..$CURRENT_COMMIT"
  git log --pretty=format:'- %h %s' "$PREVIOUS_TAG..$CURRENT_COMMIT" > commits.md
  git diff --name-only "$PREVIOUS_TAG" "$CURRENT_COMMIT" > changed-files.md
  git diff --stat "$PREVIOUS_TAG" "$CURRENT_COMMIT" > diffstat.md
else
  RANGE_LABEL="$CURRENT_COMMIT"
  git log --pretty=format:'- %h %s' "$CURRENT_COMMIT" > commits.md
  git diff --name-only "$EMPTY_TREE" "$CURRENT_COMMIT^{tree}" > changed-files.md
  git diff --stat "$EMPTY_TREE" "$CURRENT_COMMIT^{tree}" > diffstat.md
fi

{
  echo "# Release Context"
  echo
  echo "Current tag: $CURRENT_TAG"
  echo "Current commit: $CURRENT_COMMIT"
  echo "Previous tag: ${PREVIOUS_TAG:-none}"
  echo "Range: $RANGE_LABEL"
  echo
  echo "## Commits"
  cat commits.md
  echo
  echo
  echo "## Changed files"
  sed 's/^/- /' changed-files.md
  echo
  echo
  echo "## Diff stat"
  cat diffstat.md
} > release-context.md

{
  echo "## English"
  echo
  echo "### Changes"
  if [ -s commits.md ]; then
    cat commits.md
  else
    echo "- No commit summary was available."
  fi
  echo
  echo "## 中文"
  echo
  echo "### 变更"
  echo "本次发布包含以下提交："
  if [ -s commits.md ]; then
    cat commits.md
  else
    echo "- 未获取到提交摘要。"
  fi
} > release-notes.fallback.md

steps.name: Generate Bilingual Release Notes with Copilot
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

npm install -g @github/copilot@1.0.70

PROMPT="$(cat <<'EOF'
You are writing release notes for SubConverter-Extended.

Use only the release context provided below. Do not invent features, fixes, platforms, or compatibility claims.
Summarize user-visible changes first. Mention maintenance or dependency changes only when relevant.
Ignore auto-generated files unless the context shows they affect users.

Return only Markdown. Do not wrap the answer in a code fence.
Do not include a downloads section; it will be appended by the workflow.

Required format:

## English

### Highlights
- ...

### Changes
- ...

## 中文

### 亮点
- ...

### 变更
- ...

Omit empty sections. Keep each language concise and accurate.
EOF
)"

PROMPT="$PROMPT

$(cat release-context.md)"

copilot -p "$PROMPT" --no-ask-user > release-notes.ai.md
grep -q '[[:alnum:]]' release-notes.ai.md

steps.name: Assemble Release Notes
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

if [ -s release-notes.ai.md ]; then
  cp release-notes.ai.md release-notes.md
  echo "Using Copilot-generated release notes."
else
  cp release-notes.fallback.md release-notes.md
  echo "Using fallback release notes."
fi

cat >> release-notes.md <<'EOF'

## Docker Images

Docker images are published to:
- `aethersailor/subconverter-extended`
- `ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended`

Supported Docker platforms:
- `linux/amd64`
- `linux/arm64`
- `linux/arm/v7`

## Downloads

### Linux (portable, glibc runtime bundled)
- **amd64**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-linux-amd64.tar.gz`
- **arm64**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
- **armv7**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-linux-armv7.tar.gz`

### Windows (portable)
- **amd64**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-windows-amd64.zip`

### OpenWrt 25.12+ APK (unsigned)
Install with `apk add --allow-untrusted ./<package>.apk`. Choose the APK whose OpenWrt architecture suffix matches `apk print-arch`.
User configuration is created at `/etc/subconverter/pref.toml` on first start and is not overwritten by upgrades.
- **x86_64**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-openwrt-x86_64.apk`
- **aarch64**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-openwrt-aarch64_generic.apk`, `...-aarch64_cortex-a53.apk`, `...-aarch64_cortex-a72.apk`
- **armv7**: `SubConverter-Extended-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-openwrt-arm_cortex-*.apk`

### Checksums
- `SHA256SUMS`
EOF

steps.name: Download all artifacts

steps.name: Generate checksums
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

find artifacts -type f \( -name '*.tar.gz' -o -name '*.zip' -o -name '*.apk' \) -print | sort | while read -r file; do
  sha256sum "$file" | sed 's#  artifacts/[^/]*/#  #'
done > SHA256SUMS

cat SHA256SUMS
duplicate_names="$(find artifacts -type f \( -name '*.tar.gz' -o -name '*.zip' -o -name '*.apk' \) -printf '%f\n' | sort | uniq -d)"
if [ -n "$duplicate_names" ]; then
  echo "::error::Duplicate release asset names: $duplicate_names"
  exit 1
fi
mkdir release-assets
find artifacts -type f \( -name '*.tar.gz' -o -name '*.zip' -o -name '*.apk' \) \
  -exec cp '{}' release-assets/ \;
cp SHA256SUMS release-assets/SHA256SUMS

|

steps.name: Re-verify draft assets and tag identity
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REVISION"
test "$(git rev-list -n 1 "$VERSION")" = "$REVISION"
test "$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/$VERSION^{}" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$REVISION"
release_state="$(gh api \
  -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
  "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$VERSION" \
  --jq '[.draft, .immutable] | @tsv')"
if [ "$release_state" = $'true\tfalse' ]; then
  echo "publish_needed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
elif [ "$release_state" = $'false\ttrue' ]; then
  echo "publish_needed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "::error::Release $VERSION is neither a mutable draft nor an immutable publication: $release_state"
  exit 1
fi

mkdir verified-assets
gh release download "$VERSION" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --dir verified-assets
python3 scripts/ci/release_manifest.py verify \
  --root verified-assets \
  --manifest verified-assets/RELEASE-MANIFEST.json

python3 - "$REVISION" "${{ needs.merge-manifest.outputs.dockerhub_digest }}" "${{ needs.merge-manifest.outputs.ghcr_digest }}" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

revision, dockerhub_digest, ghcr_digest = sys.argv[1:]
manifest = json.load(open("verified-assets/RELEASE-MANIFEST.json", encoding="utf-8"))
if manifest["revision"] != revision:
    raise SystemExit("release manifest revision changed")
if manifest["images"]["dockerhub"]["digest"] != dockerhub_digest:
    raise SystemExit("Docker Hub digest changed")
if manifest["images"]["ghcr"]["digest"] != ghcr_digest:
    raise SystemExit("GHCR digest changed")
PY

|
set -euo pipefail

for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do
  immutable="$(gh api \

    "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$VERSION" \
    --jq '.immutable')"
  [ "$immutable" = "true" ] && exit 0
  [ "$attempt" -eq 6 ] && break
  sleep 2
done
echo "::error::Published Release $VERSION did not become immutable."
exit 1

|
set -euo pipefail
for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do
  if gh release verify "$VERSION" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; then
    exit 0
  fi
  [ "$attempt" -eq 6 ] && break
  sleep 2
done
echo "::error::GitHub release attestation verification failed for $VERSION."

steps.name: Advance latest only after full release verification
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail
VERSION="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}"
inspect_digest() {
  docker buildx imagetools inspect "$1" | awk '$1 == "Digest:" {print $2; exit}'
}
OLD_DOCKERHUB="${{ steps.version_images.outputs.dockerhub_latest }}"
OLD_GHCR="${{ steps.version_images.outputs.ghcr_latest }}"
test "$(inspect_digest aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest)" = "$OLD_DOCKERHUB"
test "$(inspect_digest ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest)" = "$OLD_GHCR"

rollback_latest() {
  echo "::warning::Restoring the pre-release latest pointers after a promotion failure."
  docker buildx imagetools create \
    -t aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest \
    "aethersailor/subconverter-extended@$OLD_DOCKERHUB" || true
  docker buildx imagetools create \
    -t ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest \
    "ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended@$OLD_GHCR" || true
}

if ! docker buildx imagetools create \
  -t aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest \
  "aethersailor/subconverter-extended:$VERSION"; then
  rollback_latest
  exit 1
fi
if ! docker buildx imagetools create \
  -t ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest \
  "ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended:$VERSION"; then
  rollback_latest
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$(inspect_digest aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest)" != "${{ needs.merge-manifest.outputs.dockerhub_digest }}" ] || \
   [ "$(inspect_digest ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended:latest)" != "${{ needs.merge-manifest.outputs.ghcr_digest }}" ]; then
  rollback_latest
  echo "::error::latest digest verification failed."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Re-verify formal version tags are absent
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail
remote_tag_commit="$(git ls-remote \
  "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY.git" \
  "refs/tags/$VERSION^{}" | awk '{print $1}')"
if [ "$remote_tag_commit" != "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sha }}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Remote annotated tag $VERSION no longer peels to the approved source SHA."
  exit 1
fi
assert_absent() {
  local registry="$1"
  local repository="$2"
  local token_url="$3"
  local token
  local status
  token="$(curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error "$token_url" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
  status="$(curl -sS -o /tmp/manifest -w '%{http_code}' \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" \
    -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json' \
    "https://$registry/v2/$repository/manifests/$VERSION")"
  if [ "$status" = "404" ]; then
    return
  fi
  if [ "$status" = "200" ]; then
    echo "::error::$registry/$repository:$VERSION appeared during the build; refusing overwrite."
  else
    echo "::error::Could not re-prove absence of $registry/$repository:$VERSION (HTTP $status)."
  fi
  exit 1
}
assert_absent \
  registry-1.docker.io \
  aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
  "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull"
assert_absent \
  ghcr.io \
  aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
  "https://ghcr.io/token?service=ghcr.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull"

steps.name: Promote tested candidates
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

if [ "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}" = "dev" ]; then
  ARCHES=(amd64)
else
  ARCHES=(amd64 arm64 armv7)
fi
for arch in "${ARCHES[@]}"; do
  test -s "digests/${arch}.txt"
  grep -Eq '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' "digests/${arch}.txt"
done

TAGS="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tags }}"
IMAGE_NAMES=(
  "aethersailor/subconverter-extended"
  "ghcr.io/aethersailor/subconverter-extended"
)

for IMAGE_NAME in "${IMAGE_NAMES[@]}"; do
  SOURCES=()
  for arch in "${ARCHES[@]}"; do
    candidate="ci-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}-${arch}"
    if [ "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}" = "release" ]; then
      candidate="ci-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}-${arch}"
    fi
    SOURCES+=("${IMAGE_NAME}:${candidate}")
  done
  for TAG in $TAGS; do
    if [[ "$TAG" == "$IMAGE_NAME:"* ]]; then

steps.name: Verify manifest platforms
steps.run:
|
set -euo pipefail

if [ "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mode }}" = "dev" ]; then
  PLATFORMS=("linux/amd64")
else
  PLATFORMS=("linux/amd64" "linux/arm64" "linux/arm/v7")
fi
TAGS="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tags }}"
DOCKERHUB_DIGEST=""
GHCR_DIGEST=""
for TAG in $TAGS; do
  echo "Inspecting $TAG"
  for attempt in $(seq 1 6); do
    if docker buildx imagetools inspect "$TAG" > manifest.txt; then
      break
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -eq 6 ]; then
      echo "Failed to inspect $TAG"
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
  done

  cat manifest.txt
  digest="$(awk '$1 == "Digest:" {print $2; exit}' manifest.txt)"
  if [[ ! "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
    echo "::error::Could not resolve the manifest digest for $TAG."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "$TAG" == ghcr.io/* ]]; then
    GHCR_DIGEST="$digest"
    echo "ghcr_digest=$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  else
    DOCKERHUB_DIGEST="$digest"
    echo "dockerhub_digest=$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  fi

  for PLATFORM in "${PLATFORMS[@]}"; do
    if ! grep -Eq "Platform:[[:space:]]+${PLATFORM}$" manifest.txt; then
      echo "Missing platform ${PLATFORM} in ${TAG}"
      exit 1
    fi
    docker pull --platform "$PLATFORM" "$TAG"
    actual_revision="$(docker image inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.revision" }}' "$TAG")"
    actual_version="$(docker image inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.version" }}' "$TAG")"
    test "$actual_revision" = "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sha }}"
    test "$actual_version" = "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}"
  done
done
test -n "$DOCKERHUB_DIGEST"
test -n "$GHCR_DIGEST"
if [ "$DOCKERHUB_DIGEST" != "$GHCR_DIGEST" ]; then
  echo "::error::Docker Hub and GHCR manifest digests differ."
  exit 1
fi

  echo "::error::expected_dev_sha must be a full 40-character Git SHA."

  if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "::error::new requires an explicit unused vX.Y.Z version."
    exit 1

     git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$VERSION" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "::error::Tag $VERSION already exists. Historical versions are frozen; choose a new version."
    exit 1
  fi
elif [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::sync_only must not carry a release version."

|

if ! git merge "${{ steps.request.outputs.dev_sha }}" --no-commit --no-ff; then
  conflicted_files="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
  for file in $conflicted_files; do
    if [[ "$file" == README*.md || "$file" == docs/images/readme-flow-*.svg ]]; then
      git checkout --ours "$file"
    else
      git checkout --theirs "$file"
    fi
    git add "$file"

fi

git checkout HEAD -- README.md 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout HEAD -- 'README-*.md' 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout HEAD -- 'docs/images/readme-flow-*.svg' 2>/dev/null || true
git add README.md README-*.md docs/images/readme-flow-*.svg 2>/dev/null || true

if [ -f .git/MERGE_HEAD ]; then

elif ! git diff --staged --quiet; then

registry_digest() {
  local registry="$1"
  local repository="$2"
  local version="$3"
  local token_url="$4"
  local token
  token="$(curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error "$token_url" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
  curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --head \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" \
    -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json, application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json' \
    "https://$registry/v2/$repository/manifests/$version" | \
    awk 'BEGIN {IGNORECASE=1} /^docker-content-digest:/ {gsub("\r", "", $2); print $2}'
}

for baseline in .github/release-baselines/v*.json; do
  version="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["version"])' "$baseline")"
  gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$version" > release.json

  tag_object="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$version" --jq '.object.sha')"
  tag_type="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$version" --jq '.object.type')"
  if [ "$tag_type" = "tag" ]; then
    tag_commit="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/tags/$tag_object" --jq '.object.sha')"
  elif [ "$tag_type" = "commit" ]; then
    tag_commit="$tag_object"
  else
    echo "::error::Unsupported tag object type $tag_type for $version."
    exit 1
  fi

  dockerhub_digest="$(registry_digest \
    registry-1.docker.io \
    aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
    "$version" \
    "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull")"
  ghcr_digest="$(registry_digest \
    ghcr.io \
    aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
    "$version" \
    "https://ghcr.io/token?service=ghcr.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull")"

  python3 scripts/ci/verify_release_baseline.py \
    --baseline "$baseline" \
    --release-json release.json \
    --tag-commit "$tag_commit" \
    --dockerhub-digest "$dockerhub_digest" \
    --ghcr-digest "$ghcr_digest"
done

gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
  --jq '.[] | select(.draft == false and .prerelease == false) | .tag_name' | \
while IFS= read -r version; do
  has_manifest="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$version" \
    --jq 'any(.assets[]; .name == "RELEASE-MANIFEST.json")')"
  [ "$has_manifest" = "true" ] || continue

  immutable="$(gh api \
    -H 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
    "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$version" \
    --jq '.immutable')"
  if [ "$immutable" != "true" ]; then
    echo "::error::Modern formal Release $version is not immutable."
    exit 1
  fi

  manifest_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-manifests/$version"
  mkdir -p "$manifest_dir"
  gh release download "$version" \
    --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
    --pattern RELEASE-MANIFEST.json \
    --dir "$manifest_dir"

  tag_object="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$version" --jq '.object.sha')"
  tag_type="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$version" --jq '.object.type')"
  if [ "$tag_type" = "tag" ]; then
    tag_commit="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/tags/$tag_object" --jq '.object.sha')"
  elif [ "$tag_type" = "commit" ]; then
    tag_commit="$tag_object"
  else
    echo "::error::Unsupported tag object type $tag_type for $version."
    exit 1
  fi

  dockerhub_digest="$(registry_digest \
    registry-1.docker.io \
    aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
    "$version" \
    "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull")"
  ghcr_digest="$(registry_digest \
    ghcr.io \
    aethersailor/subconverter-extended \
    "$version" \
    "https://ghcr.io/token?service=ghcr.io&scope=repository:aethersailor/subconverter-extended:pull")"

  python3 - "$manifest_dir/RELEASE-MANIFEST.json" "$version" "$tag_commit" "$dockerhub_digest" "$ghcr_digest" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

path, version, tag_commit, dockerhub_digest, ghcr_digest = sys.argv[1:]
manifest = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))
expected = (
    manifest.get("version") == version
    and manifest.get("tag") == version
    and manifest.get("revision") == tag_commit
    and manifest["images"]["dockerhub"]["digest"] == dockerhub_digest
    and manifest["images"]["ghcr"]["digest"] == ghcr_digest
    and dockerhub_digest == ghcr_digest
)
if not expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"published release identity drifted for {version}")
print(f"Verified immutable published identity {version} at {tag_commit}")
PY
done
